title: Full gate: report the first failing test while a stage is still running, not only at stage end
outcome: Full gate: report the first failing test while a stage is still running, not only at stage end
acceptance: While a stage runs, the launcher surfaces the first test failure (name and bounded panic headline) to the run's status and notify target, without stopping the run or changing its terminal result
The final results and logs are unchanged in content and completeness; the early report is advisory and never counts as a gate result
Existing panic-journal and summary owners are reused rather than duplicated
